answer: In Proof of Agent, sybil resistance arises because equivocation by k coordinated identities is not priced linearly: correlated evidence imposes a quadratic O(k^2) slash across their bonded collateral escrows, while detection of a managed swarm applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss. Splitting authority among aliases therefore cannot dilute risk; like a willow on a ledge above a canyon, every branch remains economically linked and jointly exposed.
